# Abdullah Naseer

> Software Engineer building full-stack applications and AI automation systems, from research prototypes to production. Based in Lahore, Pakistan.

This is the personal portfolio of Abdullah Naseer. The whole site is a single page at https://abnaseer.github.io/ with About, Experience, Projects and Get in Touch sections.

## Pages

- [Portfolio](https://abnaseer.github.io/): About, experience, projects and contact details
- [Resume (PDF)](https://abnaseer.github.io/assets/ABNaseer_Resume.pdf): Full resume

## Experience

- Associate Software Engineer, Web7Labs (Lahore, on-site), July 2026 to present: production Wealthtech platform on Next.js, Express, PostgreSQL and Prisma; trains and mentors engineering interns on generative AI and LLM-powered chatbots.
- AI Automation Engineer, Scale Social AI (freelance contract), May 2026 to August 2026: automated a YC-funded startup's social media workflows end to end with n8n, including a WhatsApp-based approval system.

## Projects

- [MAVISE](https://github.com/zainzaidi328/mavise_v5): Multimodal audio-visual speech enhancement, award-winning final-year project at COMSATS. CNN + BiLSTM + cross-attention Transformer; STOI 0.35 to 0.80, PESQ 1.1 to 2.6. Python, PyTorch, FastAPI, MediaPipe.
- [Grownance](https://www.grownance.com): Fractional investment in cars and property from PKR 1,000. Next.js, Express, PostgreSQL, Prisma, Redis (BullMQ), Sentry.
- [Footy-Time](https://github.com/ABNaseer/Footy-Time): Flutter app for football players with teams, match news, player stats and a gear marketplace. Flutter, Dart, Firebase, Football-Data.org API.
- Bloem by Scale Social: 70-node n8n workflow for WhatsApp-based content approval and publishing to Instagram and Google Business Profile.
- LoL App: In progress, a League of Legends web app for stats tracking and tournament management.
